purpose: All remaining supported native scenario authoring contracts, without execution or false executable registration.
executionPolicy: Inert authoring data. runtimeRecipeDraft never supplies row.fixture. Every executionBlocker must be implemented/reviewed before promotion to an executable runtime fixture; authored is not executed or passed.

defaults.variantPolicy: Fresh world per branch/faction. Paired controls share seed, deterministic instance identity, logical tick and all inputs except the explicitly declared changed variable. Require equal permitted digests/intents only for hidden-state fairness pairs, not risk, workforce or other deliberately different observed-state controls. D cases override difficulty; multiplayer uses real clients; calibration preserves its own sample matrix.
defaults.actorPolicy: Resolve legal faction-owned capabilities, prices, footprints, durations, source/drain types and weapon domains from pwActorDefinitions/TechTreeService. Bind unique actual inherited actors. Choose concrete passable out-of-footprint positions only after a checked physical map setup; no name-only capability guesses.
defaults.inputPolicy: All preset creation/balances/queues precede first observation. Later events use ordinary opponent/shared commands or pinned native losses. Never inject AI plans, contacts, paid completion, earned income or success flags.
defaults.timingPolicy: maximumTick is an authored outer ceiling, not a measured pass. At binding freeze original per-phase travel/build/train/impact bounds independently before AI decisions and add exact before/after milestones. A missing event or exhausted ceiling fails, never passes vacuously or renews from a planner retry estimate.
defaults.assertionsPolicy: All required branches need independent native assertions plus forbidden predicates. Missing/truncated setup, input, history, action or oracle is unavailable/failed, never success. Planner explanations and dispatch alone are not applied useful effects.
defaults.cleanupPolicy: Dispose scoped fault interceptors, listeners, scene and browser contexts in finally paths. Lifecycle cases intentionally retain one app realm across matches. Never turn these authoring controls on in ordinary gameplay.
defaults.reportPolicy: Keep raw proof local/ignored. Deterministic code evaluates assertions. Model input is only the bounded existing summary (maximum 8192 UTF-8 bytes), with explicit omitted counts and narrow causal projections when needed.
defaults.reviewStatus: Source and contract review only; no gameplay recipe, test, lint, type check, formatter or dedicated validation command executed. Catalog generation is authoring only.
defaults.lifecyclePolicy: User correction 2026-10-21: save/load is single-player coverage. Multiplayer coverage uses real host transfer, reconnect and stale-command fencing. Do not invent coordinated multiplayer save/load or require a save-to-multiplayer transition.
